attribution.note: Marcus states and endorses both parts in his own explanatory prose.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the contrast, limited pattern-matching quantifier, and present-tense observation.

contract.note: The calculator contrast makes unaided numerical calculation a fair ordinary reading. Support depends on accepting integer multiplication as a proxy; the packet does not directly test floating-point arithmetic.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous tests report only 55% and 59% accuracy on three-digit multiplication, supporting poor arithmetic reliability under the contract's ordinary reading.
The study describes strong performance on some tasks and findings consistent with learned pattern matching. It complements e1 but is the same study, not independent corroboration.

The company disclosure supports strong benchmark performance, though it does not isolate pattern matching. Its version is misdated: the supplied history dates v4 to December 19, 2023, not March 15. It remains before the evaluation cutoff and reports historical GPT-4 results.

reviews.rationale: Under the fair ordinary reading, the packet supports strong performance on some learned-pattern tasks alongside unreliable unaided arithmetic. High word-problem scores and tool-assisted calculation do not overturn that narrower contrast. The e3 version-date error is identifiable from its supplied history and does not make the source unusable.
